# Colorado Cash Home Buyers

> Local cash home buyer serving Denver and Northern Colorado along
> the Front Range (Denver, Larimer, Weld, Boulder, Adams, Arapahoe,
> Douglas, Jefferson, and Broomfield counties). We buy single-family
> homes, condos, townhomes, and small multifamily for cash, close in
> 7-30 days, and pay all closing costs. No agent commissions, no
> repair credits, no contingencies. Locally operated, funded with
> our own capital.

## Service area

Front Range and Southern Colorado. Primary cities:

- Denver (80202-80294)
- Aurora (80010-80019)
- Colorado Springs (80901-80951)
- Pueblo (81001-81012)
- Boulder (80301-80310)
- Fort Collins (80521-80528)
- Loveland (80537-80539)
- Greeley (80631-80634)
- Longmont (80501-80504)
- Windsor (80550)

Other communities: Lakewood, Westminster, Arvada, Thornton, Centennial,
Highlands Ranch, Castle Rock, Brighton, Erie, Lafayette, Louisville,
Broomfield, Commerce City, Northglenn, Wheat Ridge, Englewood,
Littleton, Parker, Berthoud, Evans, Pueblo West, Fountain, Monument,
Manitou Springs.

## Offer terms

- Free, no-obligation written cash offer within 24 hours
- Close in as fast as 7 days, typical close 14-30 days
- Properties bought as-is — no repair credits, no inspection
  re-negotiations
- Colorado Cash Home Buyers pays all closing costs
- We use our own capital — no financing or appraisal contingencies
- Closing at a Front Range title company

## Seller situations we work with

- Pre-foreclosure (Colorado uses a Public Trustee foreclosure
  process — unique among US states — under CRS Title 38 Article 38;
  Public Trustee Sale timelines run 110-125 days; extensive cure
  rights; we close before auction)
- Inherited / probate houses (CO Probate Code Title 15; informal vs
  formal probate; district court for the county where decedent resided;
  typically 6-12 months for informal cases)
- Divorce sales (CO is equitable distribution, NOT community property;
  91-day waiting period from filing)
- Distressed / as-is properties (fire damage including Marshall Fire
  rebuilds, hail damage common along the Front Range, foundation
  issues from bentonite/expansive clay soils, code violations,
  hoarding, vacant homes)
- Buckley Space Force Base military moves (PCS orders)
- Anschutz Medical Campus / UCHealth physician relocations
- CU Boulder, CSU, UNC faculty relocations
- NCAR / NIST / NOAA federal-research transfers
- Out-of-state inheritances (entire transaction handled remotely)
- Tired landlords and investor exits

## When a cash sale is not the right choice

If the property is in good condition, the seller has time for a
60-90 day MLS listing, and there are no urgency factors — a
traditional listing will typically net more after costs.

## What we are not

We are not realtors. We do not list properties on the MLS. We are
a professional home-buying operation purchasing with our own funds.
